utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in for the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, thanks — if you can bring a sturdy gloves-and-tools setup, that’d be great. I’m sorting the list now, so I’ll tell you the exact jobs as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring sturdy gloves and a basic tools kit. Just send me the job list when it’s ready, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Hana — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you check the donation list first and bring tape, a marker, and a few sturdy boxes if you have them? If you can, arrive a little early so we can sort everything before people get here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the donation list, bring tape, a marker, and some sturdy boxes, and I’ll come a bit early to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got on hand and make a quick supplies list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be great—thanks, Cleo. I might’ve forgotten what we already have, so a list would really help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll sort through the supplies and write up a quick list for you, then we can see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I think we still need a clear list of repairs, who’s bringing tools, and a time for the pickup runs. I’m a little worried we’ll miss something if we don’t sort the logistics first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can make a simple list of repairs and tool needs, then we can match people to each one. If you want, I can also help pick a time for the pickup runs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, what’s the main thing you need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly my front door latch — it’s been sticking for weeks. If there’s time, I’d also love a quick look at the kitchen sink.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll note the front door latch as the priority. If there’s time, I’ll also ask someone to check the kitchen sink.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon, and folks are already setting aside tools and spare parts. If you’ve got anything to donate, Gus, now’s a good time to check the shed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll take a look in the shed and see what I can spare. If I’ve got anything useful, I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Gus. Even a few workable bits can make a big difference, and I’ll let you know the drop-off details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure everyone gets the invite.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — can you also tell me where the drive’s meeting spot will be?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll ask and send you the exact meeting spot as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really okay taking a look at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m happy to take a look at it. Just point me to the repair drive and I’ll check it out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and keeping the list tidy. What should we prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the stuff that’s preventing people from using their homes, then the safety issues, and after that the smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — I’ll put housing-blocking repairs first, then safety, then the smaller fixes. If you have any specific homes or issues in mind, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that sounds good. I’ll keep my list handy and be there to help organize things.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll do that and let folks know we can use extra hands too. See you there, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’m still gathering the details, but I can let you know what needs fixing once I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Uli—just give me a shout when you’ve got the list, and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira — I’m glad to help bridge folks together for the repair drive. What’s the next thing you want me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you tell folks we still need a few more volunteers for Saturday morning, especially anyone handy with tools? I’ll swing by later with the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that Saturday morning still needs a few more volunteers, especially anyone handy with tools. Looking forward to the supply list when you swing by later.
